<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="ecc_agent_script_file"><ecc_agent_script_file action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><checksum/><description>Get JSON with Proxmox LXC containers' config</description><directory>false</directory><name>Proxmox_CTs_config.sh</name><parent display_value="SSHScriptFiles">48deb961ff123100ab8fffffffffff07</parent><script>#!/bin/bash

# 1. Get name of local node
local_node=$(sudo pvesh get /cluster/status --output-format json \
  | tr ',' '\n' \
  | grep -A 3 '"local":1' \
  | grep '"name"' \
  | head -n1 \
  | sed -E 's/.*"name":"([^"]+)".*/\1/')

# 2. Get list of CTs from local node
vmids=$(sudo pvesh get /nodes/"$local_node"/lxc/ --output-format json \
  | tr ',' '\n' \
  | grep '"vmid"' \
  | sed -E 's/.*"vmid":([0-9]+).*/\1/')

# 3. Get configs and create JSON array
echo "["

first=1
for vmid in $vmids; do

    tmpfile="/tmp/$vmid"

    # pull machine-id from container
    sudo pct pull "$vmid" /etc/machine-id "$tmpfile" >/dev/null 2>&1

    # read machine-id
    machine_id=$(cat "$tmpfile" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n')

    # get container config
    cfg=$(sudo pvesh get /nodes/"$local_node"/lxc/"$vmid"/config --output-format json)

    # append machine_id into JSON
    cfg=$(echo "$cfg" | sed "s/}$/,\"machine_id\":\"$machine_id\"}/")

    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then
        first=0
    else
        echo ","
    fi

    echo "$cfg"

done

echo "]"</script><script_attachment/><source/><sys_class_name>ecc_agent_script_file</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>karel.benes</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-27 10:16:30</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>eedb5802c30a7610982a7d0ed4013102</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Proxmox_CTs_config.sh</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>ecc_agent_script_file_eedb5802c30a7610982a7d0ed4013102</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>karel.benes</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-03-14 06:42:02</sys_updated_on><use_attachment>false</use_attachment><version/></ecc_agent_script_file></record_update>
